Advanced Search

Select one or more search criteria if you need to focus your search.
Age Group:     a. ALL refers to the entire listing of USTA Divisions. Your search will return Junior, Adult, NTRP, Family and Wheelchair divisions.

b. YOUTH refers to USTA Junior Divisions in which a child 18 years old or younger can participate in.

c. ADULTS refers to USTA Adult Divisions such as Adult Age Group and NTRP divisions.
Start Date:

Location:      
Search within miles
Sanctioning:     a. ALL refers to the entire listing of tournaments on the USTA Tournament Searchable Schedule.

b. SANCTIONED refers to tournaments that agree to follow USTA rules and regulations of play. These tournaments usually count for ranking.

c. NON-SANCTIONED refers to tournaments that may not follow USTA rules and regulations of play. These tournaments do not count for ranking.
Shortcut:    
National/Section/District:     a. To narrow your search results you can select an option from this dropdown menu.

For example, if you choose Southern you will be shown all the tournaments in the Southern Section. If you choose Southern/Georgia you will be shown all the tournaments in the Southern/Georgia District.
Division:     a. To narrow your search results you can select a division from this dropdown menu.

For example, if you wanted to see all the Men’s 50 Singles divisions you can select that option from the dropdown menu and then be shown all tournaments that meet that criteria.
Category:     a. To narrow your search results you can select an option from this dropdown menu.

For example, if you choose National Junior Schedule Event you will be shown all the events on the National Junior Schedule. If you are not sure what a Category for a particular tournament is you should reach out to the Section/District office that approved the tournament for more information on Categories.
Surfaces:     a. To narrow your search results you can select a surface from this dropdown menu.

For example, if you choose Grass you will be shown all the events that are played on grass.
